summary: Frontend-only verification of FASE B asset/feature updates on the preview URL (mobile 390x844, IT default). Verified: (1) page-footer with michele-real-lab.jpg on Home and Ricette, (2) MikiAvatar/michele-avatar.jpg load on 'Il Tuo Laboratorio', (3) NON-registered 7-day local device trial on both nav-tab-maestro and nav-tab-diagnosi (paywall -> local-trial-start -> content unlocked + local-trial-banner '7 giorni', persisted in localStorage mikilab_local_trial across reload), (4) Mohammadreza rename on mohammed-assistant card + out-of-scope chat refusal starting with 'Sono Mohammadreza, il tuo assistente per ...'. All 4 requested items PASS. Note: IntroGuide dialog overlay must be dismissed (intro-close-btn) before bottom-nav is clickable.

Persist an 'intro guide seen' flag so IntroGuide does not reappear (and block bottom nav) on every reload
Reduce overlap of floating Radio/Parla buttons with footer content on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: PaywallGate local trial is device-local only (localStorage) and trivially resettable by clearing storage; no server-side enforcement. PRO backend endpoints (/api/maestro/vision, /api/capo/plan mode=pro) still require auth, so trial users will get 401s inside the unlocked section — verify which sub-features actually work during a non-registered trial.
Multiple 401 console errors on every page load for anonymous visitors (auth/session or subscription status calls) — guard these calls when no session exists to keep console clean.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To test app UI: add_init_script setting localStorage mikilab_onboarding={"done":true}, then after load click [data-testid="intro-close-btn"] to dismiss the IntroGuide overlay, otherwise all bottom-nav clicks are intercepted by the dialog overlay. To retest the fresh trial button, clear localStorage 'mikilab_local_trial' and reload (don't clear it inside add_init_script, or reload-persistence checks will falsely fail).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect found in the new features. The initial nav-click failures were caused by the IntroGuide Radix DialogOverlay covering the bottom nav, and the initial persistence failure was a test-script artifact (init script removed the trial key on every navigation).
